title: Flows are blind to licence gates - no licence in the Flow drawer, and a refused gate is a silent no-op

detail: description written; maturity planned -> needs-decision (the Flow-drawer layout for a flow carrying MORE than one licence is an open call)

maturity needs-decision -> in-progress. The open call (one licence block per gated key vs a bare 'a licence exists' note) is settled by looping the SAME block the Model Library drawer already renders: N=1 today on every shipped flow, and N=2 stacks without a new layout. Peer claims on MpiFlowLibrary.js (MPI-567/599/608) are all released.
